اختلجت (form VIII)
# اِخْتَلَجْتُ (iḵtalajtu) /ix.ta.lad͡ʒ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِخْتَلَجَ (iḵtalaja)
# اِخْتَلَجْتَ (iḵtalajta) /ix.ta.lad͡ʒ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِخْتَلَجَ (iḵtalaja)
# اِخْتَلَجْتِ (iḵtalajti) /ix.ta.lad͡ʒ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِخْتَلَجَ (iḵtalaja)
# اِخْتَلَجَتْ (iḵtalajat) /ix.ta.la.d͡ʒat/: thi
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
